gaps.title: Logic Apps callback URL and SAS caller migration unresolved
gaps.description: The Logic Apps Request trigger does not expose the exact BizTalk-relative URL. Callers must use the deployed callback shape https://<workflow-host>/api/wf-shipment-notification/triggers/Receive_ShipmentNotice/invoke/<relativePath>?api-version=<version>&sig=<secret>; the SAS-bearing URL is a shared secret even though no application-level caller identity is added.
gaps.resolutionGate: Inventory and update every caller, store the SAS-bearing callback URL in Key Vault, restrict its distribution, and approve rotation/revocation and cutover evidence.
